known_secrets.text: Yara has privately reduced how many new kilns she'll fire per season.
Tarek Sabha does not know about this quiet reduction.
The far end of the Old Canal Bed holds graves from the fever years before the full Turning.
The wells ran shallow three full years before the river's course fully shifted.

unknowns: Meaning of the Signs on the seals
